events.verdict: Dosunmu (MIN) steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to Trail Blazers (POR).
Avdija (POR) releases his arm and makes marginal contact with McDaniels (MIN) as he brings the ball up in transition.
Clingan (POR) is firming up when he makes marginal contact with Randle (MIN) while setting the pick.
McDaniels (MIN) contests Grant's (POR) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Avdija (POR) initiates contact with Randle's (MIN) arm on the perimeter.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Holiday (POR) come together at the same spot as they navigate the pick, and the body to body contact that occurs is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Grant (POR) before it goes out of bounds.
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Avdija's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Camara (POR) brings his arm down and avoids making contact with Randle's (MIN) arm while contesting his shot attempt.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Avdija (POR) come together as they navigate the pick and marginal contact occurs.
Avdija (POR) and McDaniels (MIN) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Gobert (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Holiday's (POR) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Clingan (POR) is already in Randle's (MIN) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Grant (POR) contests DiVincenzo's (MIN) shot attempt, and the contact after the release is marginal.
Clingan (POR) legally contests Gobert's (MIN) layup attempt.
Randle (MIN) commits a take foul on Grant (POR).
Clingan (POR) cleanly intercepts the inbound pass.
